manifest_notes: API: https://environment.data.gov.uk/water-quality (OpenAPI at /water-quality/api/swagger, version 1.3.1); no key, no documented rate limit; the legacy Water Quality Archive was retired on 2025-12-11.

Observations are fetched with POST /data/observation (empty body), Accept: text/csv, limit=2500, two half-year windows per year: dateTo is exclusive and the API rejects multi-point queries spanning a year or more (HTTP 400).
phenomenonTime has no UTC offset; it is read as Europe/London local time (see docs/water/api_notes.md).
The archive is updated within two working days of a new sample and refreshed monthly (corrections possible), so this snapshot is dated by the download stamps below.

slice.description: Environment Agency North East region, area X (Northumberland, Durham and Tees), sub-area H (Northumberland & Tyne); sampling point type F6 (freshwater rivers).
